title: Workers' Compensation Referral Intake and the Start of Treatment
content:
# Intake and the start of treatment

## 1. Registration

A Workers' Compensation Referral is registered with the claim number, carrier, adjuster, employer and date of injury exactly as the carrier or employer gives them.

## 2. Entry requirements

Treatment starts only when the program's entry requirements are on file: the physician order where the program requires a physician order, the job description where the program requires the employer's job description, a completed FCE where the program requires a completed FCE baseline, and the incident report where the program requires the employer's incident report.

Stated in the terms of each program: treatment starts only when the treating physician's order is on file where the program requires a physician order, the employer's written job description is on file where the program requires it, a completed Functional Capacity Evaluation is on file where the program requires one before entry, and the employer's incident report is on file where the program requires it. Whether a document is on file is read from the referral record, not from a caller's statement.

## 3. Return-to-work goal

Where the program requires a return-to-work goal, the goal agreed with the employer is recorded at evaluation.

## 4. Authorization and pending claims

- Where the program requires adjuster authorization, treatment beyond the visits the program allows before authorization needs an authorization in force.
- A claim with compensability pending starts treatment only where the program allows treatment while pending, and only for the program's number of visits while pending.

## 5. Referrals that never start

A referral that never starts because the claim is denied, authorization is refused or the worker declines is closed.

## Entry check (input, judgement, result)

| Program requires | On the referral record | Treatment may start? |
|---|---|---|
| a physician order | no physician order date on file | No |
| a job description | job description not on file | No |
| a completed FCE before entry | no completed FCE on file | No |
| an incident report | incident report not on file | No |
| each document it requires | every one of them on file | the entry requirements are met |

The last row states only that the entry requirements are met; authorization and a pending compensability position are judged under section 4.
